chunks: And from him (Al-Hilli) from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He was asked about a man who takes from the zakat (alms-tax) upon him is the sadaqat al-fitr (charity of breaking the fast), he said: 'No.'

key_terms.صَدَقَةُ الْفِطْرَةِ: Sadaqat al-Fitr (Charity of breaking the fast/Eid al-Fitr charity)

ai.seo_question: Does a person who receives zakat have to pay sadaqat al-fitr?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the relationship between zakat eligibility and the obligation of sadaqat al-fitr, ruling that a recipient of zakat is exempt from paying it. This ruling underscores the principle that sadaqat al-fitr is a purification for the fasting individual, and those already supported by the community's zakat funds are relieved of this personal burden, reflecting the Shia juristic view on the interplay between communal support and individual religious duties.
